summary: Freight Technologies, Inc. filed a Form 6-K disclosing that its board approved a one-for-ten reverse split of its ordinary shares on October 8, 2026, with split-adjusted trading beginning October 19, 2026 on Nasdaq under symbol FRGT and new CUSIP G51413170. Outstanding shares fall from 16,814,200 to 1,681,420, with fractional shares of one-half or more rounded up and lesser fractions cancelled. The action aims to satisfy Nasdaq's $1.00 minimum bid price requirement; Transhare Corporation serves as exchange agent. This is a routine listing-compliance capital-structure action, not an M&A special situation.
